notes: Original experimental paper (not a review). H2 uptake is the authors' own: Table 1 lists NAC-1.5-600 at 2.96 wt% as 'This work', and H2 isotherms were measured on the static volumetric ASAP 2020 at 77 K up to 1 bar (Fig. 3, SI Fig. S4 repeat runs). Tables 2 and 3 cite the authors' earlier CO2-capture paper [34] for textural and compositional data, but the paper does not say its H2 uptake values were published before, so duplicate_data does not apply. record.json is_retracted is false and the text carries no retraction notice. Carbon is the largest component by mass in every sample that has an H2 value (C 56.8-70.7 wt% for the activated carbons; 56.9 and 61.9 wt% for CP-400 and CP-600), so all measured sorbents are carbon sorbents. SI file (si1) holds TEM, XPS and a repeat-isotherm figure; no criterion depends on it.
